requirements.general: Biotechnology / IT / Psychology: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Minimum Credit in five (5) subjects including Mathematics and any science subject. UEC: Minimum grade B in three (3) subjects including Mathematics and any science subject. Built Environment: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Pass with minimum Credit in five (5) subjects including Mathematics, OR Pass O-Level with minimum credit in three (3) subjects including Mathematics. UEC: Minimum grade B4 in three (3) subjects including Mathematics. Computer Science: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Minimum credit in five (5) subjects including Additional Mathematics OR Maths and any one (1) science subject OR Its equivalent. UEC: Minimum grade B in three (3) subjects including Additional Mathematics and any one (1) science subject. Medical and Health Science: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Minimum credit in 5 subjects including any of these 3 subjects: Biology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, English, and Applied Science. UEC: Minimum grade B in any three (3) of the following subjects: Biology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, English, Applied Science. Engineering: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Minimum Credit in five (5) subjects including Mathematics and any two (2) science subjects. UEC: Minimum grade B in three (3) subjects including Mathematics and any two (2) science subjects. Medicine OR Dentistry: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Minimum grade B in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics OR Additional Mathematics, and any one (1) subject. Dentistry: Minimum grade B4 in four (4) subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics OR Additional Mathematics, and any one (1) subject. UEC: Minimum grade B4 in three (3) subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics OR Mathematics OR Additional Mathematics. Pharmacy: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Pass SPM with a minimum grade of B in five subjects below, OR Pass O-level with a minimum grade of C in five (5) subjects: Mathematics OR Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and any one (1) subject. Science e.g. BSc (Hons) Biochemistry: SPM/SPMV/O Level: Minimum credit in five (5) subjects including Mathematics and any two (2) science subjects. UEC: Minimum grade B in subjects: Mathematics and any two (2) science subjects.
